- Handle factor 2 separately: while n is even, divide n by 2 and track 2 as current largest.  
- Iterate odd candidate d from 3 up to sqrt(n) (recomputed as d*d <= n), dividing out fully when n % d == 0 and updating largest; increment d by 2.  
- After loop, if n > 1, n itself is prime and is the largest factor; return the tracked largest (max of last recorded and n).
